sql_template: SELECT settlement_id, settlement_date, payment_date, COUNT(*) AS line_items, SUM(charged_amount) AS gross_gmv, SUM(settled_amount) AS net_settled, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_number) AS invoices FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement WHERE is_active = true AND settlement_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY settlement_id, settlement_date, payment_date
